exposure: type of delivery (vaginal birth, vaginal birth with episiotomy, cesarean section)
outcome: postpartum sexual function (desire, arousal, lubrication, orgasm, satisfaction)
cohort: A total of 240 postpartum women with a mean age of 28.03 +/- 6.02 years, who gave birth at a tertiary hospital from June to December 2019.
finding: Cesarean section was associated with higher scores in sexual functioning compared to other delivery modes at three months postpartum, with lower mean pain scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with higher scores in sexual functioning (desire, arousal, lubrication, orgasm, satisfaction) and lower pain scores compared to vaginal birth and vaginal birth with episiotomy.
